full_name: Clair Null | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Maury Green Fellow Emory University
bio: Clair Null is an assistant professor of global health at Emory University. Trained as a development economist but working in close collaboration with epidemiologists and environmental microbiologists, she focuses her research on issues related to water, sanitation, and hygiene (WaSH) in sub-Saharan Africa.
